applies_to.workload: long-form decode on the serve path: 3896-token prompt + 128 new tokens (shape L of the p1-slots rig)
applies_to.not_applicable: short JSON (max-new 16, shape S) does not benefit: measured -1.28% and -0.38% on the two 4096 runs and -1.83% at 4224; the production 3200-slot default stays in place for that shape

model.sha_trust: registered and fully verified previously; not re-hashed for this profile

engine.build: VS2022 17.14 + CUDA 12.8.1; p0-baseline tree, serve path

gates.note: the calibrated runs ran with every research gate off (MTP/COMPACT not set); setting any of them voids this profile

evidence.not_in_git: evidence lives in the local research repo (D:/work/StrataUnified run tree, results/ is not published to GitHub); identity.json / raw/ / result.json per arm are the sources of the numbers below

reference_4224.note: not better than 4096 and leaves only 317.4 MiB; 4096 chosen

evidence.measurement_notes: one cold + one hot native per arm (2 native per arm, hot sample judged), serve path, n=1 per shape per native; gpu_peak is a sampled whole-card high-water (100 ms), not the exact allocator peak; percentages are as recorded by the rig - recomputing from the 2-dp TPS columns can differ by 0.01-0.02 pp

invalidators.rule: model.sha256_prefix must prefix the target model's verified SHA256; an unknown target SHA fails closed (no profile is applied blind)
quant must be exactly UD-IQ3_S; no cross-quantization conversion - slot counts and VRAM peaks are not transferable between quants
GPU name, VRAM total, driver version or compute capability changes; cross-card reuse is refused outright, with no scaling or conversion of any kind
--qwen35-cache-slots 4096, --qwen35-threads 8, --qwen35-ubatch 4096 and --max-context 4096 must match the runtime configuration item by item; nothing is silently reused
COMPACT (STRATA_QWEN35_COMPACT_SLOTS / compact_slots) or MTP (MTP / MTP_TXN) enabled: rejected - the profile was measured with every research gate off
requested output below applies_to.output_tokens_min (128) is out of scope: short JSON measured -0.38%..-1.28% here and -1.83% at 4224, so the 3200 default applies
measured whole-card peak headroom below 300 MiB on the target host: rejected before launch (the 4224 arm leaves only 317.4 MiB and is already not selected)
